english_description: Learn practical English for asking people to repeat, explain, spell and clarify information.
somali_description: Baro Ingiriis la isticmaalo markaad codsanayso ku celin, sharaxaad, higgaad iyo caddeyn.

english_description: Learn polite English for greetings, introductions, thanks, apologies and respectful everyday contact.
somali_description: Baro Ingiriis edeb leh oo ku saabsan salaanta, isbarashada, mahadnaqa, raalli-gelinta iyo xushmadda.

english_description: Learn how to give personal details clearly in forms, offices, schools and services.
somali_description: Baro sida loo bixiyo macluumaadka qofka si cad marka la buuxinayo foomam ama lala hadlayo adeegyo.

english_description: Learn the English used on signs, notices and warnings in public places.
somali_description: Baro Ingiriiska ku qoran calaamadaha, ogeysiisyada iyo digniinaha meelaha dadweynaha.

english_description: Learn English for length, weight, volume, temperature, size and everyday measurements.
somali_description: Baro Ingiriiska cabbirka dhererka, miisaanka, mugga, heerkulka iyo cabbirrada maalinlaha ah.

english_description: Learn numbers for counting, prices, dates, rooms, phone numbers and percentages.
somali_description: Baro tirooyinka loo adeegsado tirinta, qiimaha, taariikhaha, qolalka, telefoonka iyo boqolleyda.

english_description: Learn English for paying, banking, receipts, refunds, discounts and money services.
somali_description: Baro Ingiriiska lacag-bixinta, bangiga, rasiidyada, lacag-celinta, qiimo-dhimista iyo adeegyada lacagta.

english_description: Learn how to discuss time, days, months, appointments, opening hours and schedules.
somali_description: Baro sida looga hadlo waqtiga, maalmaha, bilaha, ballamaha, saacadaha furitaanka iyo jadwalka.

english_description: Learn English for directions, buildings, rooms, maps, positions and finding places or things.
somali_description: Baro Ingiriiska tilmaamaha, dhismayaasha, qolalka, khariidadaha, booska iyo helidda meelaha ama waxyaabaha.

english_description: Learn how to describe people, objects, colours, shapes, sizes, feelings and weather.
somali_description: Baro sida loo sharaxo dadka, walxaha, midabbada, qaababka, cabbirka, dareenka iyo cimilada.

english_description: Learn English for common routines at home, work, school, shops and online.
somali_description: Baro Ingiriiska hawlaha caadiga ah ee guriga, shaqada, iskuulka, dukaanka iyo internetka.

english_description: Learn practical English for buses, taxis, trains, airports, tickets, driving and parking.
somali_description: Baro Ingiriis waxtar leh oo ku saabsan basaska, taksiyada, tareennada, garoomada, tigidhada, wadista iyo baarkinka.

english_description: Learn English for phone calls, messages, emails, meetings, instructions and online contact.
somali_description: Baro Ingiriiska wicitaannada, farriimaha, iimayllada, shirarka, tilmaamaha iyo xiriirka internetka.

english_description: Learn English for symptoms, doctors, pharmacies, hospitals, medicine, emergencies and care.
somali_description: Baro Ingiriiska calaamadaha xanuunka, dhakhaatiirta, farmashiyaha, isbitaalka, daawada, gurmadka iyo daryeelka.

english_description: Learn practical English for buying, ordering, preparing and talking about food.
somali_description: Baro Ingiriiska maalinlaha ah ee la xiriira iibsashada, dalbashada, diyaarinta iyo ka hadalka cuntada.

english_description: Learn English for clothes, sizes, colours, shoes, laundry, tailoring and shopping.
somali_description: Baro Ingiriiska dharka, cabbirrada, midabbada, kabaha, dhaqidda, tolidda iyo wax iibsiga.

english_description: Learn English for renting, buying, repairs, utilities, neighbours, moving and home safety.
somali_description: Baro Ingiriiska kirada, iibsashada guri, dayactirka, biilasha, deriska, guurista iyo badbaadada guriga.

english_description: Learn English for job searches, applications, CVs, interviews, salaries, leave and workplace life.
somali_description: Baro Ingiriiska raadinta shaqo, codsiyada, CV-ga, wareysiyada, mushaharka, fasaxa iyo goobta shaqada.

english_description: Learn English for classrooms, subjects, homework, teachers, exams, attendance and online learning.
somali_description: Baro Ingiriiska fasalka, maaddooyinka, layliska, macallimiinta, imtixaannada, xaadiriska iyo waxbarashada internetka.
